scenarios.title: Flash-loan blocked
scenarios.expected: Base holds the unsupported amount and disburses zero when the witness-backed cap is below the borrower's minimum.

scenarios.title: Synchronized settle
scenarios.expected: A fresh Unichain trade supports full settlement in one callback. The full-loop target is about 2 seconds, pending measurement.

scenarios.title: Stale hold → auto-release
scenarios.expected: The stale verdict holds the request. Fresh reference trades before the deadline trigger a new verdict and release the supported amount.

scenarios.title: Local cancel / expire
scenarios.expected: Base releases unused collateral locally while retaining enough to cover any amount already disbursed.
